name: receipt-id-and-dedupe
sql: SELECT id,object_hash FROM lean_receipts WHERE strategy=? AND kind=? AND id=? UNION ALL SELECT id,object_hash FROM lean_receipts WHERE strategy=? AND kind=? AND dedupe_key=?

plan.detail: SEARCH lean_receipts USING PRIMARY KEY (strategy=? AND kind=? AND id=?)
SEARCH lean_receipts USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_lean_receipts_2 (strategy=? AND kind=? AND dedupe_key=?)

name: team-identity-update
sql: DELETE FROM lean_teams WHERE strategy=? AND kind=? AND id=?

plan.detail: SEARCH lean_teams USING COVERING INDEX lean_teams_identity (strategy=? AND kind=? AND id=?)

name: feed-seek
sql: SELECT h.* FROM lean_teams t JOIN lean_heads h ON h.strategy=t.strategy AND h.kind=t.kind AND h.id=t.id WHERE t.strategy=? AND t.team_id=? AND t.kind=? AND (t.published_at,t.id)<(?,?) ORDER BY t.published_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT ?

plan.detail: SEARCH t USING PRIMARY KEY (strategy=? AND team_id=? AND kind=? AND (published_at,id)<(?,?))
SEARCH h USING PRIMARY KEY (strategy=? AND kind=? AND id=?)

name: hot-retirement
sql: SELECT * FROM lean_versions WHERE strategy=? AND published_at<? AND inline_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY published_at,kind,id,revision LIMIT ?

plan.detail: SEARCH lean_versions USING INDEX lean_hot_due (strategy=? AND published_at<?)
